question: Should Crabbox adopt operator-managed macOS Screen Sharing credentials as a supported External-provider contract, and what proof is required before that contract ships?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing provider target and security-sensitive configuration surface, while maintainers have explicitly left both feature acceptance and the real-endpoint proof threshold unresolved.

options.title: Sponsor after live proof
options.body: Accept the feature direction after the branch is refreshed and a redacted real External macOS authentication, reset, and cleanup run succeeds.

options.title: Sponsor with proof waiver
options.body: Accept the new contract using the existing shim and exact-head evidence while explicitly owning the absence of real endpoint validation.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the External provider Linux-only until a suitable endpoint and maintainer sponsor are available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after the branch is refreshed and a redacted real External macOS authentication, reset, and cleanup run succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the prior maintainer repair and owns the most relevant merged External credential and macOS WebVNC history.
